intro.title: Everything I've worked on since 2019.
intro.kicker: Newest first. These are real jobs, with what I was brought in to do and what actually came out of it.

entries.title: Lead configurator and operations advisor
entries.summary: Rebuilding a four server network from one badly overloaded Paper box, and training the staff so they can run it without me.
highlights: Split survival, creative, minigames and the hub across a Velocity proxy sharing one LuckPerms tree
Got average tick time from 41ms down to 12ms by auditing plugins and retuning chunk loading
Wrote a 32 page operations handbook and ran four training sessions with the staff team

entries.title: Discord architect and community manager
entries.summary: Took a 400 member Discord with no real structure and turned it into a 12,000 member community with a mod team that runs itself.
highlights: Built a 40 channel layout where access opens up as people verify and stick around
Set up ticket routing and auto moderation, which cut manual mod actions by roughly 70%
Hired and trained eleven moderators against a written escalation ladder

entries.title: Full server configuration
entries.summary: Everything for a seasonal SMP. Economy, land claims, custom items, and the quest chain that carried the first season.
highlights: Balanced a closed loop economy across shops, jobs and a player market
Configured 60 custom items in ItemsAdder with MythicMobs encounters to match
Season launched on time and still had 38% of its players at day 30

entries.title: Staff lead and permissions rescue
entries.summary: Called in after a permissions rewrite locked half the staff team out mid season. Fixed it, then stayed on to run the team.
highlights: Rebuilt a broken 90 group LuckPerms tree into 14 inherited tracks over a weekend
Set up shift rotas and handover notes that worked across three timezones
Turnover went from losing someone every month to two people leaving in nine

entries.title: Bot configuration and automation
entries.summary: A run of automation contracts across eleven Discord communities. Verification, tickets, logging, and relays back into Minecraft.
highlights: Built one verification and ticket stack, then rolled it out to all eleven servers
Linked in game punishments to Discord roles through webhook relays
Documented every setup so each owner could edit it without calling me

entries.title: Started configuring, never really stopped
entries.summary: Learned this the usual way. Running a friend's survival server, breaking it, and working out exactly why it broke.
highlights: Went from single Spigot servers to multi server BungeeCord networks
Picked up permissions, economies and world management the hard way
Started taking paid work in late 2021
